title: Sea Haven
meta_description: Escape to Sea Haven, a modern 2BDR 2BR condo just steps from the stunning beaches of Florida's Emerald Coast. The stylish interior, dream balcony, and outdoor amenities, invite you to embrace relaxation and adventure at this resort-style retreat.
description_expanded:
Sea Haven is beckoning for you to experience the outdoors, from the beach to the dream balcony to the communal outdoor pool area. This modern haven is steps from the stunning sandy shores of Florida's Emerald Coast, offering a true escape for both relaxers and adventurers alike.

Live in luxury as you step into the newly renovated, 2BDR 2BR condo. Natural light fills the space, and complements the stylish decor, creating an elegant yet rustic ambiance. With laundry in unit, a fully equipped kitchen, and additions like the built-in WiFi speaker systems, comfort and convenience are guaranteed during your stay.

The balcony provides the perfect outdoor space to enjoy from morning till night. Barstool seating lines the counter, so you can catch the ocean breeze while you sit and enjoy your morning coffee. Adorned with tall Adirondack chairs and string lights, the space seamlessly transforms into an evening oasis. Kick back and feel your stress melt away as you watch the sunset paint the sky with color.

Sea Haven offers ample resort-style amenities at your fingertips. The pool area is complemented with a hot tub, poolside lounge chairs for tanning, and a spacious shaded cabana with plenty of seating. Nearby grills and picnic tables complete the outdoor experience, and invite you to end the night with an ideal BBQ setup. When you've had plenty of pool time, head down to the beach and enjoy the waves.

Situated only 10 minutes from the coveted Alys Beach, Sea Haven offers not only the tranquility of beachside living but also easy access to shopping, dining, and exploring. Whether you're seeking a serene beach retreat or an adventurous coastal getaway, Sea Haven invites you to embrace the luxury of beachfront living on the stunning Emerald Coast of Florida.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- This unit is located on the 3rd floor, foot traffic may be heard from surrounding units.
- There are 2 sleeper sofas in the living room. One is a full size, one is a twin size
- This condo is pet-friendly
- There is an elevator, but it is maintained by the condominium and may not always be operational.
- The communal pool is not heated.

Parking Details:
- There are only 2 parking spots available on the premises, and each guest will receive 2 parking passes. These passes must be displayed at all times.
- If you choose to park your car underneath the building, please be considerate and use only one space.
- If you have two cars, park one car directly behind the other.
- Please follow the parking guidelines and signs. Failure to comply may result in your vehicle being towed at your own expense.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
